nodes.label: Config Translation Generator
nodes.rationale: Derives web/public/locales/en/config/{global,cameras}.json from Pydantic field titles/descriptions so UI labels can never drift from the config schema; those JSON files must never be hand-edited.

nodes.label: extract_translations_from_schema
nodes.rationale: Recursively walks JSON schema resolving $ref, additionalProperties, items and anyOf so nested Pydantic models flatten into a label/description tree the frontend can key into by config path.

nodes.label: get_detector_translations
nodes.rationale: Walks the DetectorConfig discriminator mapping and hoists fields identical across every detector type into a shared block, keeping only per-type unique fields, to avoid duplicating the same strings for every detector.

nodes.label: sanitize_camera_descriptions
nodes.rationale: Rewrites global-scope wording ('for all cameras; can be overridden per-camera') to 'for this camera' when the same schema is rendered in a camera context.

nodes.label: filters_attribute Translation Variant
nodes.rationale: Produces a parallel filters_attribute block with object wording rewritten for attribute filters (face, license_plate, courier logos). The rewrite list is kept explicit rather than a blanket s/object/attribute/ so unrelated text such as 'JSON object' never accidentally flips. The frontend's buildTranslationPath routes filters.<attr>.<field> lookups to filters_attribute.<field> when <attr> is in model.all_attributes.

nodes.label: OpenAPI Auth Spec Generator
nodes.rationale: docs/static/frigate-api.yaml is generated, not hand-maintained, so it stays complete and current; exempt lists are read from the auth dependency closure instead of duplicated so the generator cannot drift from frigate/api/auth.py.

nodes.label: build_app
nodes.rationale: Mirrors the router set of frigate.api.fastapi_app but omits the global admin dependency and runtime state, since only the route table and per-route dependencies are needed for classification.

nodes.label: read_exempt_rules
nodes.rationale: Reads EXEMPT_PATHS/EXEMPT_PREFIXES out of the require_admin_by_default closure via inspect.getclosurevars rather than copying them, keeping the generator automatically in sync.

nodes.label: _handler_enforces_camera
nodes.rationale: Many handlers call require_camera_access inside the body, which dependency introspection cannot see, so the check is recovered from __code__.co_names bytecode. Known ceiling: a call hidden behind a helper function would be missed.

nodes.label: classify_route
nodes.rationale: Promotes an 'any authenticated' route to camera-scoped when the handler enforces per-camera access in its body; admin and public are left alone because for admin the role is the binding requirement and the camera check is only defensive.

nodes.label: _classify_base
nodes.rationale: Effective access is the intersection of route-level markers and the global secure-by-default admin dependency: a route declaring allow_any_authenticated or allow_public on a non-exempt path is reported as admin, because admin is what actually gets enforced.

nodes.label: security_for
nodes.rationale: AUTHENTICATED and CAMERA both map to the user scheme; camera scoping is conveyed via the access note and x-required-role because OpenAPI security cannot express per-resource scoping.

nodes.label: base_document
nodes.rationale: Blanks info.title deliberately: a docusaurus-openapi-docs convention that suppresses the generated API introduction page.

nodes.label: strip_volatile_defaults
nodes.rationale: Epoch-like numeric defaults (datetime.now() baked in at import time) make the export non-deterministic and document a meaningless frozen epoch, so they are stripped. Noted proper fix: default those route params to None and resolve 'now' in the handler.

nodes.label: to_block_scalars
nodes.rationale: Renders multi-line strings as YAML literal blocks for readable, deterministic diffs instead of long escaped double-quoted lines.

nodes.label: _check
nodes.rationale: CI guard mode: exits non-zero with a truncated unified diff when the committed spec is stale, so contributors see exactly what regeneration would change.

nodes.label: API Access Level Taxonomy (public/any/camera/admin)
nodes.rationale: Four ordered access levels emitted as x-required-role plus a bold 'Access:' note per operation, so both machine readers and rendered docs carry the auth requirement.

nodes.label: App TypeScript Config
nodes.rationale: Strict mode plus noUnusedLocals/noUnusedParameters/noFallthroughCasesInSwitch is enabled so type errors fail the build (tsc runs before vite build), and the @/* path alias mirrors the Vite resolve alias.

nodes.label: i18next Extraction Config
nodes.rationale: The static extractor cannot resolve dynamic namespaces such as useTranslation([i18nLibrary]) or t(key, { ns: configNamespace }), so a plugin deletes the misattributed false-positive keys rather than letting them pollute the wrong namespace files. removeUnusedKeys is false to avoid dropping runtime-only keys.

nodes.label: Node-side TypeScript Config
nodes.rationale: Split as a composite project reference so the Node-executed vite.config.ts type-checks under Node module semantics without loosening the DOM app config.

nodes.label: Vite Build and Dev Server Config
nodes.rationale: Dev server proxies /api, /vod, /clips, /exports to the backend over HTTP and /ws, /live over WebSocket so the frontend runs same-origin against a real Frigate. esbuild keepNames is on because runtime code relies on function names. Only the editorWorkerService language worker plus a custom yaml worker are bundled to keep Monaco small.

nodes.label: shadcn/ui Component Config
nodes.rationale: Uses CSS variables with the slate base color and @/ aliases so generated shadcn components drop into the existing Tailwind theme without per-component color overrides.

nodes.label: Frontend Package Manifest and Scripts
nodes.rationale: Production build uses --base=/BASE_PATH/ as a substitution token so the served bundle can be rehosted under an arbitrary reverse-proxy sub-path; the e2e build uses --base=/ instead. Radix packages are pinned via overrides to avoid duplicate transitive versions.

nodes.label: Playwright E2E Config
nodes.rationale: Two projects (desktop 1920x1080, mobile 390x844) both run Desktop Chrome with a spoofed user agent because the app branches on react-device-detect UA parsing, not on viewport alone. Tests run against a vite preview server on port 4173, reused locally but not in CI.

nodes.label: Playwright Global Setup
nodes.rationale: Shells out to the npm e2e:build script before the suite so the previewed bundle always matches current source rather than a stale dist.

nodes.label: GLOBAL_ALLOWLIST E2E Error Filter
nodes.rationale: Every entry must carry a comment explaining what it silences; per-spec suppressions go through the expectedErrors fixture instead of this file so allowlist drift stays visible per-PR rather than buried in shared infrastructure. Console-level 5xx echoes cannot be URL-discriminated because ConsoleMessage.text() omits the URL, so one broad pattern covers them while the paired request-level entries enforce specificity. Entries marked TODO(real-bug) track genuine mock gaps (missing /api/review, /api/stats/history, /api/event_ids, /api/sub_labels, latest.webp, jsmpeg WS) and one real accessibility bug (DialogContent without DialogTitle).

nodes.label: FrigateApp E2E Harness
nodes.rationale: All route and WebSocket handlers must be registered before page.goto() or AuthProvider redirects to login.html. isMobile is derived from the Playwright project name rather than the viewport so it matches the UA-based branching in the app.

nodes.label: Extended Playwright test Fixture
nodes.rationale: Error assertions are hard-failing only when E2E_STRICT_ERRORS=1; otherwise collected errors are attached to the report so the suite stays green while the known mock gaps are worked through.

nodes.label: installErrorCollector
nodes.rationale: Filters at collection time so failure messages list only unfiltered errors. Only same-origin failures and status >= 500 are recorded, keeping third-party noise and expected 4xx out of the signal.

nodes.label: cameraActivityPayload Factory
nodes.rationale: Returns a JSON string because the camera_activity WebSocket topic is double-serialized: the payload field of the WS message is itself a JSON string.

nodes.label: configFactory
nodes.rationale: Deep-merges DeepPartial overrides onto the backend snapshot so a test can change one nested field without restating the whole config; arrays are replaced rather than merged.

nodes.label: withGroupedTrainingAttempt Factory
nodes.rationale: Encodes the backend's filename convention ${event_id}-${timestamp}-${label}-${score}.webp because the UI groups training attempts by the event-id prefix parsed out of the filename, not by a separate field.

nodes.label: Backend-Schema-Derived Mock Fixtures
nodes.rationale: E2E fixtures are instantiated through the real Pydantic response models (ReviewSegmentResponse, EventResponse, ExportModel, ExportCaseModel) rather than hand-written JSON so that a new required backend field fails the generator at instantiation time instead of silently drifting the frontend mocks. Peewee column lists are also checked because .dicts() responses can carry legacy columns the Pydantic response_model filters out.

nodes.label: FrigateConfig Snapshot Fixture
nodes.rationale: A real snapshot generated from the Python FrigateConfig model rather than a hand-written stub, so every field the frontend reads is guaranteed present and shaped as the backend emits it.

nodes.label: activeSessionStatus Factory
nodes.rationale: Mirrors /api/debug_replay/status which the Replay page polls every second via SWR; the active variant drives the live image, debug toggles, and objects/messages tabs.

nodes.label: Radix Dismissable-Layer Pointer-Events Leak
nodes.rationale: Guards the class of bugs fixed by de-duping @radix-ui/react-dismissable-layer across the tree: body pointer-events stuck at none, dropdown typeahead breaking, and tooltips re-popping after a dropdown closes. Tracked upstream as radix-ui/primitives#3445; the documented workaround is modal={false} on dropdowns whose parent can unmount mid-exit-animation.

nodes.label: Playwright LIFO Route Precedence
nodes.rationale: Playwright resolves page.route handlers last-registered-first. The frigateApp fixture installs default mocks before the test body runs, so per-test overrides registered inside the body always win. Every override must therefore be registered before the navigation that triggers the request, and installDefaults must be called first when a spec wants its own spy route to take precedence over the catch-all.

nodes.label: ApiMocker
nodes.rationale: The generic **/api/** handler must use route.fallback() for GET so that Playwright's LIFO route matching still lets the specific routes registered earlier win; only mutating methods are short-circuited to {success:true}. The review routes are regex-scoped to /api/review (singular) because an earlier plural **/api/reviews** glob never matched the real endpoint and review-dependent tests silently ran with no data.

nodes.label: installWsFrameCapture
nodes.rationale: Because ws-mocker intercepts the /ws route, Playwright's page-level websocket event never fires. The helper patches WebSocket.prototype.send via addInitScript before any app code runs and mirrors outbound frames into a window array the test reads back.

nodes.label: WsMocker
nodes.rationale: Simulates the Frigate WS protocol via page.routeWebSocket: onConnect handshake, camera_activity expansion, and topic-based state echo. embeddingsReindexProgress must return a completed state because a null payload leaves Explore in a permanent loading spinner (the app treats !reindexState as loading).

nodes.label: getMonacoVisibleText
nodes.rationale: Monaco is imported as a module-local object in the app and is not exposed on window, so the helpers drive and read it through the rendered DOM and keyboard instead of a programmatic API. Monaco also virtualizes long files, so only rendered lines are readable, which is acceptable for the short mocked configs.

nodes.label: BasePage object
nodes.rationale: navigateTo uses dispatchEvent('click') rather than locator.click() because React tooltip wrappers detach and reattach nav elements during route-transition re-renders, which fails Playwright's actionability checks.

nodes.label: Banned Lenient Test Patterns
nodes.rationale: Bans waitForTimeout, conditional isVisible()/count() assertions, and vacuous textContent length checks because each makes a test pass without proving anything. Every spec outside _meta must also carry at least one @mobile-tagged test so mobile coverage cannot silently lapse. An `// e2e-lint-allow` trailing comment is the only escape hatch.

nodes.label: Export page spec
nodes.rationale: The backend inserts the Export row with in_progress=True before FFmpeg starts, so the same id appears in both /jobs/export and /exports during a run; the page must show the rich progress card and suppress the binary-spinner ExportCard. Multi-review export pads each item by REVIEW_PADDING (4s per edge) and must send either new_case_name or export_case_id, never both. Creating a case must not navigate the user off the review page.

nodes.label: Face Library spec
nodes.rationale: Guards the stuck body pointer-events bug when the last image in a grouped-recognition dialog is classified: the modal DropdownMenu enters its Radix Presence exit animation, the classify response resolves, SWR drops the image, the parent unmounts the still-animating layer, and DismissableLayer never pops its body pointer-events entry. Fixed with modal={false} on the desktop FaceSelectionDialog dropdown. Reproduces only when the mock resolves within ~0-200ms.

nodes.label: Live page spec
nodes.rationale: Absorbs the PTZ preset-dropdown regressions from the deleted ptz-overlay.spec.ts: after selecting a preset the Presets tooltip must not re-pop and keyboard input must not re-open the menu. Fullscreen (key 'f') is only smoke-tested because headless Chromium rejects fullscreen without a user gesture.

nodes.label: Camera clone dialog spec
nodes.rationale: New-camera clones bundle every section into one atomic add PUT to avoid per-section validation ordering issues. The spatial-mismatch warning and existing-camera PUT fan-out are deliberately not asserted here: the shared mock fixture ships every camera at 1280x720 and the schema mock is empty, so a clone onto an existing mock camera produces no diff and no PUT.

nodes.label: Explore spec
nodes.rationale: InputWithTags only renders when semantic_search.enabled, so search tests override config with model:'genai' (not in JINA_EMBEDDING_MODELS) to skip local model-state gating. SearchFilterGroup only renders when hasExistingSearch, so filter tests navigate with ?labels=person. Similarity search is entered via ?search_type=similarity&event_id=<id>; the planned similarity_search_id param does not exist in the app.

nodes.label: installChatStreamOverride
nodes.rationale: page.route() cannot produce a streaming response, so the test monkey-patches window.fetch via addInitScript to return a real ReadableStream emitting NDJSON chunks over time. This is the only way to validate chunk-by-chunk assistant-bubble rendering, and it also records outgoing request bodies on window.__chatRequests.

ConfigForm
nodes.rationale: Thin wrapper around RJSF (@rjsf/shadcn) that centralizes schema transformation, uiSchema merging, i18n-aware error transformation, and the Frigate theme so every config section renders consistently instead of each section wiring RJSF itself.

nodes.label: splitUiSchemaOverrides
nodes.rationale: Section configs express uiSchema overrides with dot/wildcard path keys (e.g. "filters.*"), which RJSF cannot consume directly, so keys are split into plain uiSchema entries and path overrides applied separately.

nodes.label: applyUiSchemaPathOverrides
nodes.rationale: Walks the JSON Schema to expand "*" segments against both properties and additionalProperties (dict schemas), so one override can target every provider/label key without enumerating them.

nodes.label: applyLayoutGridFieldDefaults
nodes.rationale: Any node declaring ui:layoutGrid implicitly needs ui:field LayoutGridField; defaulting it avoids repeating the pairing in every section config.

nodes.label: FieldMessagesContext
nodes.rationale: Deliberately bypasses RJSF's per-field uiSchema for ui:messages because @rjsf/core Form.js caches state.uiSchema across renders (processPendingChange updates formData immediately but not uiSchema), leaving stale messages attached when a condition flips back to false; React context re-runs consumers directly on value change.

nodes.label: sectionConfigs registry
nodes.rationale: Single registry keyed by config section name centralizes field ordering, grouping, hidden/advanced fields, uiSchema overrides and overrideFields so the generic ConfigForm stays schema-driven and section-specific UI hints live in one place per section.

nodes.label: ConfigFieldMessage
nodes.rationale: Renders a single field-scoped alert with optional locale-aware documentation link, so warnings appear inline next to the offending field rather than only at the section header.

nodes.label: ConfigMessageBanner
nodes.rationale: Section-level counterpart to ConfigFieldMessage: renders the list of currently-true ConditionalMessage entries above the form.

nodes.label: LiveFormDataContext
nodes.rationale: Mirrors in-flight section form data outside RJSF because RJSF memoizes SchemaField by deep equality and can skip re-rendering a widget (notably when reverting a field to its saved value) even though data it depends on changed.

nodes.label: face_recognition section config
nodes.rationale: Camera level warns when the global feature is off or when `person` is not in the camera's tracked objects, since faces are only searched inside person detections; large model_size gets an info note about cost.

nodes.label: database section config
nodes.rationale: Only exposes `path`, which requires a restart because the SQLite connection is opened at startup.

nodes.label: birdseye section config
nodes.rationale: Objects tracking mode is meaningless when the camera's detect is disabled, so an info message flags that combination; global level exposes canvas sizing and a camera reorder control.

nodes.label: logger section config
nodes.rationale: Log levels are enums translated via a shared enumI18nPrefix, and per-logger overrides use the dict editor with logger-name labels; both fields need a restart.

nodes.label: MQTT Section Config
nodes.rationale: Every global broker connection field is restart-required because the MQTT client is established once at process startup; the base (per-camera snapshot publishing) fields are hot-reloadable.

nodes.label: Record Section Config
nodes.rationale: export.max_concurrent is hidden at camera level because concurrency is a process-wide resource limit, not a per-camera setting; sync_recordings is hidden everywhere as an operational flag.

nodes.label: no-record-role Warning
nodes.rationale: Recording silently does nothing if no ffmpeg input carries the `record` role, so the form inspects ffmpeg.inputs roles and warns before the user tunes retention that will never apply.

nodes.label: Semantic Search Section Config
nodes.rationale: Model, model_size and device are restart-required because the embedding model is loaded once into the embeddings process; `reindex` is hidden from the field list and surfaced instead via the SemanticSearchReindex action component, since it is an operation, not a stored setting.

nodes.label: audio_transcription section config
nodes.rationale: Transcription depends on audio detection, so it warns when either the audio role is missing or camera audio is disabled; at global level every field requires a restart because the model is loaded at startup.

nodes.label: ONVIF Section Config
nodes.rationale: autotracking.calibrate_on_startup is restart-required by definition (calibration only runs during camera process startup); movement_weights is hidden because it is machine-generated calibration output, not user input.

nodes.label: Proxy Auth Section Config
nodes.rationale: header_map.role_map is hidden and replaced by the ProxyRoleMap render slot, since role mapping is a key/value editor the generic schema form renders poorly; liveValidate is on because bad auth settings can lock the user out.

nodes.label: genai image_source recordings vs record disabled
nodes.rationale: Selecting `recordings` as the GenAI review image source is inert when recording is disabled, so the form cross-checks the record section (camera override first, then global) and warns instead of silently producing no descriptions.

nodes.label: genai-no-descriptions-provider Warning
nodes.rationale: Enabling GenAI in a section is meaningless unless some configured genai agent declares the `descriptions` role; the same condition is duplicated verbatim in the objects section.

nodes.label: Motion Section Config
nodes.rationale: frame_height requires a restart at global and camera level but not in replay, because replay tuning re-runs detection on stored frames rather than reconfiguring the live motion detector.

nodes.label: Notifications Section Config
nodes.rationale: At global level every generated field is hidden and the whole section is replaced by the NotificationsSettingsExtras component, because web push registration needs browser APIs a schema-driven form cannot express.

nodes.label: live section config
nodes.rationale: Stream selection only makes sense per camera, so `streams` is hidden globally and rendered by a dedicated LiveStreamsField at camera level.

nodes.label: audio section config
nodes.rationale: Warns when a camera has no ffmpeg input carrying the audio role, since audio detection silently does nothing without it; num_threads requires a restart at both levels.

nodes.label: genai section config
nodes.rationale: Providers are user-named dict keys, so every override uses "*" wildcards; api_key renders as a password field, free-form provider/runtime options fall back to a YAML editor, and key renaming is blocked to avoid orphaning role references.

nodes.label: Snapshots Section Config
nodes.rationale: required_zones is hidden at global level because zones only exist per camera.

nodes.label: model section config
nodes.rationale: Every model field requires a restart because the detector loads the model at startup; messages nudge users away from 640px inputs (models are optimized for 320) and clarify that model input dimensions are not the detect resolution.

nodes.label: SectionConfigOverrides
nodes.rationale: base/global/camera/replay layering lets a section declare common defaults once and only diff the level-specific behavior (e.g. which fields need a restart at global vs camera level).

nodes.label: MessageConditionContext
nodes.rationale: Condition functions get both saved config (fullConfig/fullCameraConfig) and in-flight formData so a message can compare a pending edit against what is already persisted (e.g. detect aspect-ratio mismatch).

nodes.label: SectionConfigOverrides
nodes.rationale: One config module per Frigate config section, split into base plus per-level partial overrides (global, camera, replay), so shared form metadata is declared once and only the deltas per rendering level are restated.

nodes.label: ConditionalMessage
nodes.rationale: Messages carry a translation key rather than literal text, and a `key` used for React list rendering and dedup, so section-level warnings stay i18n-compliant and stable across re-renders.

nodes.label: MessageConditionContext
nodes.rationale: Condition functions receive the whole FrigateConfig, the camera config, the level, and live formData so a message can react to cross-section state (e.g. record disabled) as well as unsaved edits.

nodes.label: restartRequired Field Marking
nodes.rationale: Fields listed here cannot be hot-reloaded by the Frigate backend, so the form must warn the user a restart is needed; the list differs per level because some values only bind at process startup.

nodes.label: advancedFields Progressive Disclosure
nodes.rationale: Tuning knobs that most users should never touch are hidden behind an advanced toggle instead of removed, keeping the default form approachable without losing power-user access.

nodes.label: hiddenFields Suppression
nodes.rationale: Backend-derived fields (enabled_in_config, raw_mask, mask) are present in the Pydantic-generated schema but are not user-editable, so every section hides them rather than the schema omitting them.

nodes.label: uiSchema Custom Widget Mapping
nodes.rationale: RJSF widget names (zoneNames, objectLabels, password, ptzPresets, timezoneSelect) are declared per field so the generic schema-driven form can render domain-aware pickers without special-casing sections in component code.

nodes.label: suppressMultiSchema UI Option
nodes.rationale: Pydantic Optional/Union fields generate anyOf schemas that RJSF renders as a type selector; suppressMultiSchema collapses that into a single control so users see one input, not a schema picker.

nodes.label: ui:before / ui:after Custom Render Slots
nodes.rationale: Sections that need bespoke UI (notifications registration, semantic search reindex, proxy role map, review status toggles) inject a named React component into the generated form instead of forking the form renderer.

nodes.label: Cross-Section Dependency Warning Pattern
nodes.rationale: Frigate sections are interdependent (objects/snapshots/review need detect enabled; review and genai need record enabled). Rather than blocking edits, each dependent section declares a condition over the full config and renders an info/warning message so the user learns the setting will be inert.

nodes.label: environment_vars section config
nodes.rationale: Pure dict section: relabels the additionalProperties key input as a variable name so the generic map editor reads correctly.

nodes.label: classification section config
nodes.rationale: Custom classifiers are managed elsewhere in the UI, so the `custom` field is hidden here and only bird.enabled is restart-gated.

nodes.label: ffmpeg section config
nodes.rationale: Steers users toward ffmpeg presets: manual hwaccel_args (an explicit list or a non preset- string) raises a warning, and an input path referencing a go2rtc restream that has no matching stream definition is flagged; args fields use dedicated preset-aware widgets with inherit support at the per-input level.

nodes.label: lpr section config
nodes.rationale: Mirrors face_recognition: warns when the global feature is off, and when no vehicle label (car/motorcycle) is tracked, except on dedicated lpr-type cameras where plates are detected directly; known plates and replace rules get bespoke fields.

nodes.label: hideAttributeFilters
nodes.rationale: The backend populates objects.filters with an entry for every attribute label the model knows (face, license_plate, Frigate+ couriers). Untracked attributes hide the whole collapsible; tracked ones strip threshold/min_ratio/max_ratio so RJSF does not surface them as ad-hoc additionalProperties under the restricted AttributeFilter schema. Sanitization is symmetric with the baseline so power-user YAML values survive save, since buildOverrides only emits diffs of fields the form has seen.

nodes.label: detect section config
nodes.rationale: Carries the densest field-message set in the form system: resolution must be a multiple of four, square or >1080p resolutions and aspect-ratio changes versus the saved config are flagged, detect fps above 5 is discouraged, and stationary.max_frames is warned about; a `replay` level strips everything but resolution/fps.

nodes.label: UI Section Config
nodes.rationale: unit_system is restart-required because it feeds server-rendered stats formatting; camera `order` is hidden since ordering is managed by drag-and-drop in the dashboard, not a numeric field.

nodes.label: TLS Section Config
nodes.rationale: Only `enabled` is restart-required: toggling TLS rebinds the web server, while cert/key paths are re-read without a restart.

nodes.label: detectors section config
nodes.rationale: Delegates the whole section to a custom DetectorHardwareField because detector config is hardware-shaped (multi-instance cpu/onnx/openvino/edgetpu) rather than a flat schema; per-detector model fields are hidden since the model section owns them.

nodes.label: Networking Section Config
nodes.rationale: IPv6 enablement and listen ports bind sockets at startup, so all three are restart-required.

nodes.label: auth section config
nodes.rationale: Hides admin_first_time_login and roles from direct editing and marks cookie/session/hash tuning as advanced, keeping the common path to enabling auth and resetting the admin password.

nodes.label: CameraReviewStatusToggles
nodes.rationale: Alerts/detections/description toggles are runtime WebSocket state, not config; the component force-sends ON when review genai transitions from disabled to enabled in config so runtime state does not lag behind the config change.

nodes.label: ProxyRoleMap
nodes.rationale: Renders nothing unless header_map.role is set, mirroring the proxy validator's rule; role options come from configured auth.roles with an admin/viewer fallback.

nodes.label: CameraReviewClassification
nodes.rationale: Edits alerts.required_zones / detections.required_zones through formContext.onFormDataChange so zone selection participates in the normal section save flow; compares against baselineFormData purely to color labels as unsaved.

nodes.label: SemanticSearchReindex
nodes.rationale: Reindexing is an expensive one-shot action, so it is gated behind an AlertDialog confirmation and treats HTTP 202 as success (work is accepted asynchronously).

nodes.label: sectionRenderers registry
nodes.rationale: Maps a config section key to named React renderers referenced from uiSchema ui:before/ui:after descriptors, so custom UI can be attached declaratively without the form engine importing the components.

nodes.label: NotificationsSettingsExtras
nodes.rationale: Per-camera notification toggles are written as pending overrides on each camera's notifications section so Save All/Undo All stay consistent; iOS-only PWA branch exists because iOS exposes web push only to home-screen installed apps.

nodes.label: BirdseyeCameraReorder
nodes.rationale: Drag-to-reorder writes birdseye.order in steps of 10 across all cameras and saves immediately via its own config/set PUT rather than the section's pending-data save bar; on failure it rolls the local order back to config state.

nodes.label: getSectionValidation
nodes.rationale: Central dispatch keyed on (sectionPath, level) so section-specific validators stay out of the generic ConfigSection component.

nodes.label: validateProxyRoleHeader
nodes.rationale: A populated header_map.role_map is meaningless without header_map.role defined, so the role header is required whenever role mappings exist.

nodes.label: validateDetectDimensions
nodes.rationale: Detect width/height must be even because encoders/decoders require even dimensions; enforced client-side so RJSF surfaces the error before a save round-trip.

nodes.label: validateFfmpegInputRoles
nodes.rationale: Each ffmpeg role may appear on only one input, a 'detect' role is mandatory, and hwaccel_args are meaningful only on the detect input; validated in the UI to mirror backend Pydantic constraints.

nodes.label: modifySchemaForSection
nodes.rationale: Strips the detectors schema default so RJSF does not merge {cpu:{type:cpu}} into stored detector keys, and injects a default genai provider; without this, opening a section falsely reports Modified.

nodes.label: modifyObjectsSchema
nodes.rationale: Promotes every tracked label (plus orphaned saved filters) from filters.additionalProperties to explicit properties so RJSF renders normal collapsibles instead of a key/value editor; sorted alphabetically to match the sibling track switches.

nodes.label: buildAttributeFilterSchema
nodes.rationale: Attribute filters expose only min_score/min_area/max_area because attributes never pass through _is_false_positive (no median-of-history check) and ratio tuning is not meaningful; int|float unions are flattened to number so RJSF omits the type-selector dropdown while the backend still accepts either.

nodes.label: getEffectiveDefaultsForSection
nodes.rationale: motion is anyOf [null, MotionConfig]; defaults are derived from the non-null branch so a stored null does not read as a pending change. detectors returns {} so schema defaults never add keys to the stored config.

nodes.label: synthesizeMissingFilters
nodes.rationale: The backend auto-populates objects.filters/audio.filters only at config init and not after profile merges, so the frontend synthesizes default filter entries for each label in the sibling list field (track / listen).

nodes.label: sanitizeOverridesForSection
nodes.rationale: Drops empty ffmpeg arg arrays, strips readonly detector model/model_path generated at startup, and dot-flattens logger.logs and environment_vars so nested UI objects serialize back into the flat YAML shape the backend expects.

nodes.label: useOverrideFieldLabel
nodes.rationale: Dict-keyed config paths such as filters.person.threshold have no direct translation key, so the hook drops one intermediate segment at a time and re-prefixes the dropped segment as context ('Person · Threshold').

nodes.label: CameraOverridesBadge
nodes.rationale: Shown on global sections to reveal which cameras override them; suppressed for whole-system sections (detectors, database, auth, proxy, ...) and non-per-camera enrichments, and hidden-field deltas are filtered out so users are not told about fields the UI never shows.

nodes.label: OverrideDeltaPopover
nodes.rationale: Shared 'this scope overrides these fields' badge+popover layout, extracted so profile-vs-base and camera-vs-global badges differ only in strings and border color.

nodes.label: ConfigSection
nodes.rationale: Single generic engine for every config section at global/camera/replay level; it derives a baseline snapshot, diffs form data into overrides, and PUTs only the override delta to config/set with an update_topic so most changes hot-reload instead of requiring a restart. Profile edits never set requires_restart because profile definitions only apply through PUT /api/profile/set.

nodes.label: ConfigSection.handleChange
nodes.rationale: Ignores RJSF's initial onChange while isInitializingRef is set so schema-default application is not mistaken for a user edit and does not light up the Modified badge.

nodes.label: SectionConfig descriptor
nodes.rationale: Declarative per-section description (field order, groups, hidden/advanced fields, docs links, restart-required fields, renderers, conditional messages) that lets one component serve every section.

Numeric fields render as text inputs
